title: int
i
description: truncate floats and store an integer

messages.description: if first element is float, stores and outputs it
store the value, non-integers are truncated (no output)

methods.description: send the stored value to a [receive] or [value] object that has the same name as the symbol (no output)

body: [int] stores an integer: a float in the left inlet is truncated, stored and output, a float in the right inlet is stored without output, and a bang outputs the stored value. It can also be used to truncate floats to integers.
